profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer at Cantina Labs
profile.summary:
I am a senior engineering leader with over 15 years of experience building and scaling mobile-first, real-time platforms. I hold a Master’s degree in Computer Science and have led the architecture and delivery of high-impact consumer products across iOS and Android, with a strong focus on social, interactive, and AI-powered experiences.

My work centers on platform leadership, real-time systems, and AI-integrated product architectures. I specialize in designing scalable client and backend platforms that support low-latency communication, rapid experimentation, and continuous product evolution. I partner closely with product, design, and executive leadership to translate vision into durable technical strategy—balancing speed, quality, and long-term platform health.

I have a proven track record of setting technical direction, mentoring high-performing teams, and establishing engineering standards that improve reliability, performance, and developer velocity. I am known for clear communication of complex technical trade-offs and for building platforms that enable teams to move fast without compromising scalability or operational excellence.

Core Technical Expertise

Mobile & Client Platforms
iOS (Swift, Swift Concurrency), Android, React Native, modern state management, performance optimization, accessibility, client architecture, modularization

Real-Time & Platform Architecture
Low-latency systems, real-time messaging and streaming, event-driven architectures, distributed systems, API-first design, gRPC, REST, WebSockets

Cloud & Infrastructure
AWS, cloud-native architectures, scalable backend services, CI/CD pipelines, observability, monitoring, logging, performance tuning

AI & Data-Driven Systems
AI-integrated product experiences, real-time inference integration, data pipelines, experimentation frameworks, analytics-driven iteration

Languages & Frameworks
Swift, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, C/C++, Ruby
React, Django, Ruby on Rails

Engineering Leadership & Delivery
Platform strategy, technical roadmapping, system design reviews, Agile execution, design patterns, test-driven development, documentation, cross-functional collaboration

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, iOS
positions.description:
Cantina Labs is a social AI company building next-generation real-time AI models that push the boundaries of expression, personality, and realism, bringing characters to life and redefining how people connect and create.

As a Senior Staff iOS Engineer, I provide technical leadership for Cantina’s iOS platform, shaping architecture and driving the delivery of core experiences at scale. I lead cross-functional initiatives spanning product, design, and backend systems to enable real-time, AI-driven social interactions with high performance and reliability. I influence long-term technical strategy, raise the bar for engineering excellence across mobile teams, and mentor senior engineers to build resilient, scalable systems that support the company’s evolving AI ecosystem.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, iOS
positions.description: Worked with iOS core team to build highly performant and complex iOS experience by pushing the limits on real time interactivity at Airtime. We are building a social streaming platform for togetherness that allows user to gather with friends and explore the Internet (music, videos, photos, TV, movies, games and more) together.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Amazon Prints - Developed prints service and photo builder experience using React Native application (iOS, Android) offering professional photo printing service to create standard and large prints, wall decor, cards, photo books, and canvases right from the mobile app and get it delivered by Amazon. 
     •  Work on features such as photo selection, content upload/download, image 
         loading/cropping/editing, cache management, 3d thumbnail preview, and data platform
     •  Develop RESTful APIs for prints service operations
     •  Integrate checkout flow for purchasing products through Amazon
     •  Launch various Amazon Photos products such as prints, wall decor, cards, photo books, and 
        canvases used by millions of active users
     •  Manage release pipelines for multiple production applications for feature updates and bug fixes 

Amazon Photos - Worked on Photos iOS (Swift, React Native) mobile app offering secure online backup for photos and videos, people recognition, abuse detection, data platform, and more for Amazon Photos, bringing unlimited full- resolution online photo storage to Amazon customers.

Amazon Flex - Worked on an iOS (Swift, Objective-C) app for Amazon Flex platform integrating with Amazon Cloud Cam for secure in-home and in-car delivery used by Delivery Partners to provide an efficient, on-time, and reliable delivery service to end customers.
    • Develop framework Integrating iOS Core Bluetooth that allows interacting with BLE devices either as a central or a peripheral.
   
Amazon Last Mile - Develop service for Amazon Prime Now and Flex applications to ensure delivery confirmation and safe delivery tagging for packages
    • Develop a paired geo-fence mechanism for two or more electronic devices
    • Devise proximity detection algorithms using GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) and Wifi signal strength to track delivery

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Playpower Labs, a Carnegie Mellon educational research initiative. I've worked as a Lead Game Developer at Playpower for 4 years and most of my time at Playpower has been spent creating games for building core math skills that provide a foundation for success in Science, Technology, Engineering and Math (STEM). I have worked extensively on dozens of games on multiple platforms over 4 years. I don't just believe that fun aids learning—i believe learning is fun.

• Learn World, Intelligence-Building App for kids | Oct 2014 – Aug 2015
Lead team of 3 and developed an Intelligence-Building App on iOS (Swift) for kids with HTML5 games, videos, facts, books, and design tools
• Math Planet, Math Anchor App, Samsung's Milk platform | May 2011 – Sep 2014
Lead team of 5 developers and published an award-winning platform (iOS and Android) with 100+ game levels and 80+ Common Core State Standards support for grades 1-8 with free games for fractions, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, math facts, and number sense.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Formalized licensable interactive math learning modules covering over 120 common core standards
• Built cognitive skills assessment games based on developmental psychology

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Teaching Assistant for Introduction To C Programming Language under Prof. Prasenjit Majumder (Autumn Semester 2011, for the first yearites)

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: Created innovative educational games using 6502 assembly for NES based on indian mythology of hanuman with a team in India (and an international open source community) on a MacArthur Foundation funded project for underprivileged kids around the world

positions.title: Rural Intern
positions.description: Designed data collection formats for different types of crops, collected data of different crops production and analyzed the data, at the residential Vocational Training Centre, Kawant (a tribal block in Gujarat). On the basis of report findings Deepak Foundation received funds under Kawant Livelihood Programme from the Government of Gujarat for implementation of project.

honors.title: Games4Health Competition
honors.description:
Social Wellth - Happy Fitness Challenge - Research indicates the increasing physical activity and performing it on a consistent basis is the most effective therapy for most diseases including mental health and is the most reliable way to increase your happiness. Yet too few people are engaged in such activity and have begun to seek new digital health technologies to make fitness fun and engaging. 

We developed a high-energy, interactive track & field game that will enable kids of all ages to compete in various track & field events against/with current Olympic athletes as well as their peers.

projects.title: OnTrack, interactive software targeted at promoting track & field
projects.description:
Developed a high-energy, interactive track & field game using Unity (C#) for the United
States of America Track & Field Foundation (USATFF), which will enable kids of all
ages to compete in various track & field events against their peers.

projects.title: Cozplay
projects.description:
ETC student team ‘Cozplay’ – in collaboration with Anki – was designing and developing games
for a consumer robot Cozmo scheduled for sales mid-October. Cozmo is a real-world incarnation
of a movie style robot. By leveraging his technological capabilities as well as his animated
personality, the team aimed to create memorable interactions between Cozmo and guests of all
ages.

In order to hone in on those experiences most suited to Cozmo, the team engaged in a process of
experimentation, playtesting and iteration. By the end of the semester, the team created and delivered 18 prototypes based on different prompts focused on exploring Cozmo’s capabilities and working around his limitations. The team also focused heavily in contributing on Anki’s
forums that helped shape the future SDK versions.
